cases.description: A failed weighted destination rolls back effects, history and the draw before the next input.
Malformed conditional comparison is rejected atomically.
A decisive availability operand skips a malformed later operand.
JSON core restore preserves RNG, history and future execution.
Automatic transition limit rejects activation without publishing entry effects/history.
Malformed event availability rejects activation; short-circuited entry remains executable.
Shared commits reach unfinished and host-suspended sessions while terminated sessions retain historic state.
Pending host request survives JSON restore, blocks core inputs, rejects wrong and stale results, and resumes exactly once.
Failed session activation preserves allocation, shared state and orchestration RNG.
Late retained-session semantic and structural corruption are rejected before restore publication.
